endorsements.name: Piotr Duszynski
endorsements.label: Pwn'ing You(r) Cyber Offenders
endorsements.description: It is commonly believed that Offensive Defense is just a theory that is difficult to be used effectively in practice, but that is not entirely true... During my talk along with a new service emulation technique, that will render standard port scanner results nearly useless and leave your attackers with an arduous analysis, I will focus on practical (automated) exploitation of a hackers' offensive toolbox. A few interesting attack vectors against software taken from the Internet will be presented. It turns out you can get pwn'ed even through your Nmap scripts if you are not careful enough.
